## Schedule

```{r}
library(reactable)

schedule <- read.csv(
  "../schedule.csv",
  sep = ";",
  check.names = FALSE,   # keep "08.11" as column name
  na.strings = "",       # empty cells become NA
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8" # keeps the "°C" intact
)

reactable(
  schedule,
  pagination = FALSE,
  sortable = FALSE,
  compact = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE, 
  highlight = TRUE,
  defaultColDef = colDef(
    align = "center",
    na = "",             # show empty cells as blank instead of "–"
    headerStyle = list(
      background = "#ff9e53",
      color = "white",
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
  ),
  columns = list(
    `12.11` = colDef(
    style = list(background = "#fff3cd", fontWeight = "bold"),
    headerStyle = list(background = "#e07a1f", color = "white")
    )),
  theme = reactableTheme(
    style = list(fontSize = "0.40em"),
    cellPadding = "2px 4px"
  )
)
```

## Colony PCR

### Mastermix

::: {.small-table}
| Volume [µL] | Reagent         |
|-------------|-----------------|
| 12.5        | VWR Red Taq Polymerase 2x Mastermix, 1.5 mM MgCl~2~ |
| 0.5         | 27f Primer      |
| 0.5         | 1492r Primer    |
| 0.5         | 2% BSA          |
| 11.0        | PCR H~2~O       |
| **25**      | **Total volume**    |
|             | + picked colony |
:::



## Colony PCR

### PCR programme

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width=80%}
::: {.small-table}
+------------------+-----------+----------+--------+
| Phase            | Temp [°C] | Duration | Cycles |
+==================+:=========:+:========:+:======:+
| Initial          |    95     |   5 min  |        |
+------------------+-----------+----------+--------+
| Denaturation     |    95     |  30 sec  |        |
+------------------+-----------+----------+        |
| Annealing        |    54     |  30 sec  |   35   |
+------------------+-----------+----------+        |
| Elongation       |    72     |  45 sec  |        |
+------------------+-----------+----------+--------+
| Final Elongation |    72     |  10 min  |        |
+------------------+-----------+----------+--------+
| End              |    12     |  ~       |        |
+------------------+-----------+----------+--------+
:::
